summary: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, providing notice of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for July 2, 2026, with a record date of May 26, 2026. The agenda includes standard items: election of directors, appointment of chairman, approval of compensation policy, CEO salary increase, equity grants, and reappointment of auditors. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, etc.) is triggered. This is a routine foreign private issuer report on an annual meeting.
